note: compass-labs is a Claude Code plugin. A release is a version bump on the session branch, made ready for review; the merge-triggered pipeline (.github/workflows/release.yml) tags and publishes it once the user merges.

versioning.rule: CLAUDE.md, Version Management: MAJOR for breaking changes to skill interfaces, MINOR for new skills or backward-compatible enhancements, PATCH for bug fixes and documentation updates

parts.name: merge-triggered pipeline
parts.note: The release workflow and its script, installed from the Deploy standard's starter. Changing them is a pull request like any other, so setup only confirms the pull-request run passed.

setup.name: show that the pull-request run of release.yml on the branch passed

steps.name: merge the pull request
steps.note: The user merges. The pipeline then tags and publishes

rollback: Before the merge: gh pr ready {pr} --undo, then revert the version bump on the session branch (git revert the bump commit, git push), run by Deploy or the user
After the merge: open a revert pull request with a new version, run by the user. Tags and releases are never overwritten

after_merge.name: restart Claude Code to load the new version
after_merge.run: exit Claude Code and start it again
